question.text: If shares or convertible debentures are not issued within what period from the date of receipt of inward remittance, the consideration must be refunded?

explanation.text: The Logic: As per FEMA regulations, if the equity instruments (shares or convertible debentures) are not issued within 180 days from the date of receipt of the inward remittance or date of debit to the NRE/FCNR(B)/Escrow account, the amount of consideration shall be refunded. The Trap: The 180-day period is the issuance/refund timeframe; reporting timelines under FEMA are separate rules and should not be conflated with this issuance deadline. Note: Track issuance, refund, and reporting timelines as distinct FEMA requirements -- meeting one does not satisfy the others.
